datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across the Democratic Republic of the Congo to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) representing food insecurity impact across administrative units for each month of 2019.
